{{Top|leg}}
'''The Link''' was an informal [[Sector/Legends|sector]]-wide network of gossipers that passed secrets and rumors throughout the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. The information traded by the Link was of the kind that the mainstream media refused to deal in.
